name: mgg
description: MGG — premium multi-game server hosting platform (Minecraft, Icarus & more)
author: Micka Delcato (Nextendo)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @mgg/panel && npm run build --workspace @mgg/daemon
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @mgg/shared && npm run test --workspace @mgg/daemon
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && tsc --noEmit -p apps/panel/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/daemon/tsconfig.json
